desc:
Looking at how these three are depicted to hate each other here... 🤔 they are all actually pretty disliked too, right?

- Momoyo is a textbook underground yōkai. People hate her the same direction people hate the *Subterranean Animism* cast.
- Tsukasa is a kudagitsune who will pick you apart, so pretty much nobody likes her too.
- And Chimata caused an actually serious incident.
